violation_type.title: Parent Provided Meals/Snacks - Parent Choice (26 TAC §746.3309(a)(1))
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation does not have a written agreement in regard to the parent providing snacks for their child while in care.

finding_variants.text: The operation does not have a written agreement in regard to the parent providing snacks for their child while in care.
Observed 2 children eating their lunch sent from home without a written agreement signed by the parent at the time of inspection.

During the investigation it was found that some items sent from home for meals was not provided to children based on nutritional value instead of allowing the child's parents to choose the child's meal.  The operation has since updated their procedures and handbook to meet this standard.
